 Follow Tuesday's Champions League games live 
 Published 3 hours ago 
 There are nine games in the Champions League on Tuesday, and BBC Sport will bring you every moment. 
 Galatasaray v Stuttgart (17:45)
 Shakhtar Donetsk v Sporting (17:45)
 Atletico Madrid v Bayern Munich
 Barcelona v Aston Villa - listen on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Bodo/Glimt v Lille
 Feyenoord v Inter Milan
 LASK v Slovan Bratislava
 Manchester United v Roma
 Villarreal v Paris St-Germain
 Kick-off times 20:00 GMT unless stated 
 Follow all of the action and reaction here 
 You can also listen to today's 5 Live Champions League commentary on your smart speaker. Just say "Alexa, ask BBC Sounds to play Barcelona v Aston Villa" or "Alexa, ask BBC Sounds to play the Villa match". 
 Watch highlights of every Champions League game from 22:00 on Wednesday on BBC iPlayer and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 There will also be a Champions League Match of the Day on BBC One from 22:40 to 00:00 on Wednesday. 
 How to follow the Champions League on the BBC 
 New this season: Live match updates 
 Fans of Premier League clubs can now get real-time scores live on their phone lock screen for every game.
 Simply follow your favourite football teams on the BBC Sport app for updates throughout the 2026-27 season.
